task.claim:
Let n be a positive integer and let G be the cyclic group of order n
generated by P. Fix scalars s_1, ..., s_B in Z/n. Consider words over the
alphabet {t_1, ..., t_B, v}, where the generator t_i acts on G by the
translation X |-> X + s_i P and v acts by negation X |-> -X, and a word acts
by composing the actions of its letters.

Then every word w acts on G as the affine map X |-> e(w) * X + b(w) * P,
where:

  - e(w) = (-1)^(number of occurrences of v in w), an element of {+1, -1};
  - b(w) = sum over i of a_i(w) * s_i in Z/n, where a_i(w) is the SIGNED
    count of occurrences of t_i in w, each occurrence signed by
    (-1)^(number of v letters standing to its right in w).

Consequently the orbit value obtained by evaluating the action at X = P,
namely v(w) = e(w) + b(w) in Z/n, depends only on the pair (e(w), a(w)) --
the word's "shadow". Two words with the same shadow act identically on G.
